generationProof.sourceMechanism: updateAccessIdentity increments generation only when identity string changes. No rights/auth/identity operation during native filter. If generation had changed, acknowledged client would produce saved_without_access terminal ACK and root preserves terminal state; actual normal no-access-change message + item remains proves that branch was not taken.
